title: Bezal — Local Business Intelligence for AI Agents
description: Search 7,000+ local service businesses across America by category, location, or keyword.
summary: Search 7,000+ local service businesses across America by category, location, or keyword.
offersHint: Search 7,000+ local service businesses across America by category, location, or keyword. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://app.bezal.ai/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_businesses
toolsPreview.description: Search 47,000+ local business profiles by name, category, or location.

toolsPreview.name: get_business
toolsPreview.description: Get full profile for a specific business including contact info, services, ratings, and hours.

toolsPreview.name: list_categories
toolsPreview.description: List all available business categories in the directory.

toolsPreview.name: request_service
toolsPreview.description: Submit a service request to a business on behalf of a consumer.

toolsPreview.name: search_by_service
toolsPreview.description: Find businesses that offer a specific service type. Useful when you know the exact service rather than the category — e.g. "Drain cleaning" rather than "plumbing".

toolsPreview.name: get_reviews
toolsPreview.description: Get reviews for a specific business including Bezal Verified reviews and Google rating.

toolsPreview.name: get_service_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Get services and pricing for a specific business. Falls back to the services list if no priced catalog exists.

toolsPreview.name: check_business_availability
toolsPreview.description: Check if a business has availability on a specific date using their Bezal calendar. Best-effort — only works for businesses that use the calendar feature.

toolsPreview.name: compare_businesses
toolsPreview.description: Compare up to 5 businesses side-by-side on ratings, services, BezalRank, and profile status.

toolsPreview.name: search_by_city
toolsPreview.description: Search for businesses in a specific city, optionally filtered by category. City-level matching.

toolsPreview.name: search_providers
toolsPreview.description: Legacy alias for search_businesses. Prefer search_businesses for new clients.

toolsPreview.name: get_provider_details
toolsPreview.description: Legacy alias for get_business. Prefer get_business for new clients.

toolsPreview.name: submit_quote_request
toolsPreview.description: Legacy alias for request_service. Prefer request_service for new clients.
